श्मे श्मे, ind. an abbreviation for पार्थु-
रश्मे, (see पार्थुरश्म.)

स्मेतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be smiled (used imper-
sonally).

स्मेर, अस्, आ, अम्, smiling, laughing; blown,
blooming, opened, expanded (as a flower); proud;
evident, apparent; (अस्), m. (according to some) ap-
pearance, manifestation.
—स्मेर-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्,
smiling-faced, having a smiling face.
—स्मेर-विष्-
किर, अस्, m. ‘proud bird,’ a peacock.
